data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for the Razorpay Custom UI SDK on Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: Provides a wrapper around native Android and iOS Razorpay Custom UI SDKs, enabling payment processing, event listening for success and errors, and fetching recommended payment instruments.
use_when: You need to integrate Razorpay payments with custom UI flows in a Flutter app.
Your app targets Android and iOS platforms with native Razorpay SDK support.
avoid_when: You are using standard Razorpay checkout instead of custom UI SDKs.
You need pure Dart implementations without native Android and iOS SDK dependencies.
strengths: Direct integration with native Razorpay Custom SDKs
Event-based communication for payment success and failures
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of native minimum API levels and iOS deployment targets
Limited to specific native platforms (Android and iOS)
data.setup_notes: Requires minimum Android API level 19 or higher, iOS minimum deployment target 10.0 or higher, enabling bitcode/Swift versions on iOS, and Proguard rules for Android builds.
